flashcard_questions.q: The planning phase where documents such as mood boards, scripts and storyboards are created before any filming or building begins.
The phase where the media product is actually created, such as filming, recording audio, or building a website.
The phase after the main content is created, involving editing, sound mixing, adding titles, credits and special effects.

flashcard_questions.a: A document that sets out the tasks, timescales, milestones and resources needed to complete a media project on time and within budget.
A backup plan put in place to deal with problems that might arise during a project, such as bad weather, equipment failure or a team member being unavailable.
